title: Common Errors
markdown:
| Message or symptom | Usual cause | Fix | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sc start` fails with error 577 | The driver is not signed in a way this machine accepts | Test signing on in the VM, driver test-signed by the build | 1.02, 1.04 |
| `sc start` fails with error 2 | Wrong `binPath` | Use the full path to the `.sys` file | 1.04 |
| `sc stop` fails: "the service cannot accept control messages" | No `DriverUnload` set | Set `driver->DriverUnload` | 1.04 |
| No `DbgPrintEx` output | The info level is filtered | `ed nt!Kd_IHVDRIVER_Mask 0xF`, or print at error level | 1.04 |
| Garbage or a crash when printing a `UNICODE_STRING` | Buffer treated as null-terminated, or length taken as characters | `%wZ` with the structure; lengths are bytes | 1.03 |
| `CreateFileW(L"\\\\.\\Name")` fails with 2 | No symbolic link, or a different name | `IoCreateSymbolicLink` with `\??\Name` | 2.01 |
| `CreateFileW` fails with 5 | The device's SDDL does not allow this user | Run the client as administrator (by design) | 2.01 |
| The client hangs forever in `DeviceIoControl` | An IRP was never completed | Complete every IRP exactly once on every path | 2.02 |
| Bug check `0xC4` mentioning an IRP | IRP completed twice, or touched after completion | One completion; read what you need first | 2.02 |
| `DeviceIoControl` returns `FALSE`, error 1 | The control code is not handled (`STATUS_INVALID_DEVICE_REQUEST`) | Same header in driver and client; check the code | 2.03 |
| Output arrives corrupted with `METHOD_BUFFERED` | Output written over input that was still needed | Read all input before writing output | 2.04 |
| Bug check `0x50` in your driver | Bad pointer, often from a length not checked | Validate lengths and counts before use | 2.05 |
| Bug check `0xD1` | Paged memory or code touched at DISPATCH_LEVEL (DPC, spin lock held) | Non-paged pool for such data; check IRQL rules | 3.01, 3.02 |
| Bug check `0xC4` at unload, "pool allocations not freed" | Memory leak | `!verifier 3` lists the allocations and their tags | 3.01, 5.01 |
| Bug check `0x139` (KERNEL_SECURITY_CHECK_FAILURE) | Corrupted `LIST_ENTRY` | Lock the list; remove entries once | 3.05 |
| The system freezes | Spin lock never released, or waiting while holding one | Keep spin-lock sections short; release on every path | 3.03 |
| Bug check `0xCE` | Unloaded with timers, DPCs, callbacks or IRPs still active | Cancel, flush and unregister everything in Unload | 3.04, 4.01 |
| Bug check `0x7E` or `0x3B` in a callback after unload | A notification callback was not removed | Unregister callbacks first in Unload | 4.01 |
| The VM is sluggish while the driver runs | Too much work or printing in callbacks | Record numbers only; rate-limit messages | 4.01, 4.02 |
| A timer fires immediately | Positive due time (absolute, long past) or wrong units | Negative values, 100 ns units | 3.04 |
| `InfVerif` errors | Missing or invalid `[Version]` entries | Signature, Class, Provider, DriverVer, CatalogFile | 5.04 |
